selection_reason: Cairn 2e is sixth in the active overall ranking. Its register had only two converted-map rules; an implementation audit would miss regional creation. Official Setting Seeds closes a substantial reachable source gap. Existing OSE and Root audits are already complete.

alternatives.reason: Covers only conversion of an existing map; misses regional creation and repeats a known graph boundary.

findings.conclusion: The previous register covered two converted-map operations. Fourteen regional geographic procedures now have source, concrete operation, canonical mapping and known-output acceptance cases.
findings.effect: A full Cairn L1 implementation claim cannot rely on the old two rows. The source-coverage gap is substantially reduced.

findings.conclusion: Heart plus 3–8 additional places is a regional recipe. Terrain category, path access and physical path kind are distinct dimensions.
findings.effect: Do not treat the regional count as per-hex density, equate Perilous with HX-BL-044, or merge Hidden access with trails.

findings.conclusion: Digital geometry, the exact 1–4-path interpretation and executable catalog preparation remain unresolved.
findings.effect: HX-BL-055 is a proposed profile for strategic reassessment; it does not extend HX-BL-043 approval.

verification.validation: Validated 14 operational requirements with 28 acceptance cases, run-result and product-task schemas; 14 unique bindings reuse existing common rule IDs. Canonical backlinks are append-only. The previous two Cairn rules and every existing backlog task, including 043/051/054, are JSON-equivalent. Active ranking and numerical method are unchanged. Exactly 13 scoped files.
